name: Hancock County, Ohio (United States)
description: Red field with a navy blue triangle at the hoist bearing three white discs with symbols of agriculture, industry and family, a wide white ring and stripe forming a curved border, and seventeen stars.
history: Hancock County is a county in northwestern Ohio, seated at Findlay. According to the county auditor's flag page quoted on Flags of the World, the flag was designed by M. Sean Risser of Findlay for the centennial celebration of the county courthouse; its seventeen stars stand for Ohio as the seventeenth state and for the seventeen townships.

features.role: blue triangle at the hoist, after the Ohio flag
three discs with symbols of agriculture, industry and family
circular stripe enclosing three regions for the past, present and future
seventeen stars for Ohio's admission as the seventeenth state and the county's townships
